name: Leaf Masala Curry
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: Meat (chicken or beef), cut into pieces

steps: Fry onions in a dash of oil until golden brown.
Stir in garlic, ginger, meat, and vegetables. Cook until nearly done.
Stir in leaf masala and warm water. Bring to a boil, then simmer until done.

culture.text: Curry is a dish with a spicy sauce, initially in Indian cuisine, then modified by interchange with the Portuguese, followed by the British, and eventually thoroughly internationalised. Many curries are found in the cuisines of countries in Southeast Asia and East Asia.
